# The Original Dublin Christmas Trees
> Reserve a Christmas tree in Dublin. For every tree bought, a native Irish tree is planted. A Christmas tree seller serving Dublin, Ireland.

Status: Taking reservations for Christmas 2026.

## Pages
- [Home: how it works, sponsorship, guardian tree finder and reservation form](https://conorcparis.github.io/orignal-dublin-christmas-trees/): Reserve a Christmas tree in Dublin, sponsor a native tree or find your guardian tree.
- [Privacy notice](https://conorcparis.github.io/orignal-dublin-christmas-trees/privacy.html)

## What is offered
- Christmas tree: A Christmas tree reserved through the form on the website and delivered in Dublin.
- Tree sponsorship: Sponsor a native Irish tree, optionally in honour of someone, with a certificate.
- Gift certificate: A tree sponsorship given as a gift.

## Free
- Guardian tree finder: Enter a birth month and day to find the matching tree from the 13 trees of the Celtic tree calendar. A cultural feature, not a scientific claim.
